svg.title: Same-history tree, MLP and GRU models across five leagues
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 · train/validation/test sampled cap 8,000 each · 3 neural seeds · 15 epochs · run 76efac828d6b93d5 Points: fixed-seed mean loss minus one fitted HistGradientBoosting baseline. Lines: pointwise 2.5–97.5% whole-match resampling ranges. The models and sampled passes stay fixed. Ranges exclude training/selection uncertainty; repeated-team dependence is not modelled. Each league trains on its own pre-January data, validates in January–February and tests from March. England informed the original design. No retuning, source pretraining or cross-season claim. n = sampled test matches; displacement is recorded endpoint minus start.
